initialization.optimizer: fresh AdamW; source optimizer state untouched
initialization.scheduler: new post-training stage for all arms; fresh fixed four-tier policy and early-stop history
initialization.budget: new stage at most 2h/200 epochs; inherited pretraining time recorded separately

identity.regularization: joint AB: FFN hidden dropout .05 + AdamW weight decay .0003; same parameter groups
identity.module_overlap_loss: disabled; only declared center supervision changes

fixed_loss_configuration.aggregation: original E42 per-layout terms; equal layout mean
fixed_loss_configuration.schedule: full fixed weights from the start of post-training; no ramp
fixed_loss_configuration.selection: dev_monitor500 arithmetic mean of this same total
fixed_loss_configuration.historical_difference: E42 originally ramped five terms in its first two scratch epochs and selected with G+occupancy; this post-training follows current fixed-Loss protocol using G only
fixed_loss_configuration.auxiliary_original_G: interpretation only; never selects, schedules or stops

identity.schedule: fixed full weights from first batch; no ramp, no anchor decay
identity.selection: dev500 arithmetic mean of the same total used for training; no separate proxy; no solver calls
